title: UNDERCROFT: WHOEVER STANDS LOWER ON SCREEN IS DRAWN IN FRONT
why: His note with a picture (10-31): his pillager was painted over a crowd pillager standing lower on screen, and it should be behind. The crowd was drawn in its own pass before him. Each crowd body now goes into the same y-sorted list as the walls, the posts, the party and him, keyed on its feet y, so the one lower on screen is drawn later and covers the one behind.
now: In the Undercroft you stand behind a pillager who is lower on screen than you, and in front of one who is higher.
